name: High Arctic Overseas Holdings Corp.
summary: High Arctic Overseas Holdings Corp. supplies contract drilling, equipment rentals and further oilfield services in Papua New Guinea via its subsidiaries. Services include oil and gas drilling, workovers, abandonments and heli-portable work, plus rental of cranes, vehicles, generators, camps and pumps. It also offers fire services and maintenance and integrity management to energy, mining and construction customers. It was founded in 1993 and has its head office in Calgary, Canada.
